phase: Full-paper evidence adapter validation and exploratory train-only baseline
dataset: QASPER official v0.3 train/dev archive. Resolve pinned upstream dataset/README/evaluator identities before downloading. Test archive remains unopened until a later frozen selection.
integrity_first: No model experiments before synthetic integrity tests and exact full-source/evidence audit. Render supplied title, abstract, sections and paragraphs with original UTF-8 text/newlines; keep source paragraph byte intervals. Do not invent/normalize mismatched gold or grant a whole paragraph from a truncated preview. Preserve duplicate paragraph ambiguity, float-only references, empty evidence, no-answer disagreements and mismatches in explicit counters.
splits: Official train used only for exploratory development. Dev reserved for later validation; no model scoring or question/evidence inspection there during this gate. Check metadata/hash overlap before later selection. Deterministic train paper pilot: first32sorted by SHA256 of 'ixos-qasper-pilot-v1:' plus paperID; all questions, no label-based filtering. Whole papers are families. No held-out or pretraining-clean claim.
task: Original known-paper textual evidence selection. A file per complete paper in its own corpus root; no paragraph-per-file shortcut to boost semantic coverage. Full body supplied text, not actual PDF extraction. Floats lack table/image body; count them separately. Pooled-file retrieval if later attempted is a distinct task with incomplete cross-paper labels, not official QASPER evidence score.
pilot_arms: Actual current general parent whole-token-centroid and intro-uniform, global-line and bounded-rerank, plus model-free current lexical/global-line. Each uses context2, limit1, output6000bytes, typo off, session off. Fresh resident process per paper/arm, reset before each independent question; first search reported separately from resident subsequent searches. JIT first; a native/resident equivalence sample later if justified. Do not call these warm-cache baseline timings when documents first embedded.
metrics: Verified actual UTF-8 byte overlap/coverage with original text-evidence paragraphs, best-reference convention separately disclosed; paragraph contact, fully exposed paragraph-set precision/recall/F1, and byte recall, answered/no-answer/mixed annotation subgroups. Empty evidence from negative boolean answers is distinct from unanswerable. Exact stdout/request/diagnostic token counts and wall/model/inference timings. Nonempty IR candidates are not generated answers; scores are not calibrated answerability confidence. No threshold tuning from this pilot.
session_layer: Fresh realistic multi-call/agent sessions require observed-only follow-ups/feedback and task-success labels distinct from synthetic invariance. Do not use QASPER question order as a natural conversation or labels to choose accepted results/read offsets. This gate prepares those next contracts rather than manufacturing successful sessions.
changes: Add a new harness outside frozen eval/*.py. Preserve Gate10 exact evaluator and consumed labels. No production model/architecture/default change from adapter preparation. Store raw downloaded data under ignored .tmp; public receipts contain identities/aggregates and bounded selected actual outputs with attribution. Keep negative/invalid references visible.
